Vishay document 88942 (26-Jun-2023), https://www.vishay.com/docs/88942/v60100c.pdf, read 2026-10-03T11:31:15Z (same figures in rev 23-Sep-2019): 2 x 30 A common cathode, VRRM 100 V (at least 85 V, with the node held under 85 V); VF max 0.79 V at 30 A and 25 degC, 0.70 V at 30 A and 125 degC, per diode; IFSM 320 A per diode (8.3 ms half sine). 300 A over 5 packages (10 diodes) is 30 A a diode, exactly the stated VF point, so the onboard turn-off VDS is at most 85 + 0.79 = 85.79 V (derived), against rank 1's 85.93 V. Pulse I2t per diode, I^2 x t / 3: 0.0007 A2s at 2.2 us and 0.012 A2s at 40 us (derived), against IFSM^2 x tp / 2 = 425 A2s. Limits: the datasheet states no VF above 30 A and no current sharing between 10 diodes, so equal share is assumed with no margin above the stated point; TO-220AB is through-hole, and its fit to JLCPCB assembly is not compared. P2 records no entry for the TI CD74HC4538; it is the pin-compatible TSSOP-16 alternate of the 74HC4538PW,118 and carries the same single open point. TI SCHS123E (Oct 2003), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/cd74hc4538.pdf, read 2026-10-03T11:16:27Z: dual retriggerable, resettable; truth table has R L giving Q L, and pulse rows only for the A and B trigger edges with R H, no reset-rising row; 'On power up the IC is reset'; VCC 2 to 6 V (HC types); RX min 5 kOhm, CX min 0, so R 50 to 150 kOhm and the C that gives 170 ms are inside; output pulse width tested at VCC 3 V and 5 V (0.64 to 0.78 ms at 25 degC and 3 V), K factor graphed against VCC (Figs 8 and 9); trigger inputs A and B have no rise or fall limit. Like the Nexperia sheet it has no sentence on clear release, so it ranks only if the owner or the re-rank accepts the function table as the statement (see the 74HC4538 exclusion); the spare-input levels differ from the page's wiring table (the 4538 trigger on a falling A needs B low, on a rising B needs A high) and the wiring is checked against the part's table. JLCPCB C354056 stockCount 934, canPresaleNumber 920, expand (11:24:34Z); Digi-Key CD74HC4538PWR Active, stock_available 7021, lead 12 weeks (11:32:12Z). The onsemi sibling, MC74HC4538A/D Rev. 17 (July 2026, read 11:16:28Z), prints 'Not Triggered' for reset transitions in its function table, but lists MC74HC4538ADR2G, ADTR2G and ADG as discontinued; its one orderable not marked discontinued, NLV74HC4538ADR2G (C904883), reads stockCount 0, canPresaleNumber 0 (11:18:01Z), so it is no candidate.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: the clear release is not stated in words: section 1 and Table 3 of Rev. 7 have no sentence on it; Monostable.md@23c82ca:229-236 requires it stated
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The page says a part whose clear release can trigger is excluded and that the '423 behaviour is required and stated in the datasheet; it does not say in words, and nothing read shows this part's release triggers. Nexperia 74HC4538 Rev. 7 (26 March 2024), https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/data-sheet/74HC4538.pdf (P2 read 2026-10-03T10:49:20Z; Table 3 on page 3 re-read from that copy): Table 3 is the complete function table, with pulse rows only for nA falling with nB L and for nB rising with nA H, both with nCD H, and nCD L giving nQ L; it has no nCD-rising row. Table 9 lists a recovery time 'nCD to nA, nB', Fig. 5 shows reset only as pulse shortening, and Fig. 2 shows an internal power-on reset. FU-2A's re-rank kept this part at rank 2 on the same fact ('not stated in words, so it ranks below the owner's choice'), and round 1's P4 of the 74HC423 also cited the missing nCD-rising row of its Table 3 beside the sentence. The drop leaves the monostable shortlist with one part, so a standing refutation of the 74HC423BQ,115 has no next-ranked candidate. The sheet also states pulse-width variation over temperature of +/-0.2 % typical (section 1), a figure no stocked 74HC423 gives (V36). Caveat: no sentence says the release does not trigger, and the part is below the 74HC423 on that point; the reason holds only if the owner reads 'stated' as 'in a sentence'. Other values pass as for rank 1: VCC 2.0 to 6.0 V, R 50 to 150 kOhm inside the 10 to 1000 kOhm (2.0 V) and 2 to 1000 kOhm (5.0 V) ranges, CEXT no limit, nREXT/CEXT leakage +/-50 nA at 25 degC and +/-500 nA to 85 degC, -40 to 125 degC. JLCPCB C547076 stockCount 8948, canPresaleNumber 8946 (2026-10-03T11:24:37Z); Digi-Key Nexperia USA row Active, stock_available 4779 (11:24:17Z).
